claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: LuminousMoth was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, microsoft-threat-actor-mapping, misp-microsoft-activity-group, misp-mitre-enterprise-intrusion-set, misp-mitre-intrusion-set, misp-threat-actor, misp-tidal-groups. Exact normalized-name matching and aggregation aliases do not prove one-to-one vendor cluster identity. A no-match result records completed searches, not actor nonexistence.

claims.subject: espionage

claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=knowledge-base; motivation is not inferred from sponsorship.

claims.subject: relationship--luminousmoth--verified-boundary--174fcd258944a0a7

claims.verification_rationale: Primary-source-verified taxonomy boundary; this relationship must not be converted into an exact alias.
